svg.title: Shoga-Speaks
svg.desc: Shoga, a cheerful green parrot, speaks three speech bubbles: for a developer in Roman-Urdu, for a QA tester in Dutch and for a product owner in English. Shoga-Speaks makes Claude Code explain things in your language and for your role.
